statement: The three classes that each cost a hosted release-proof cycle are closed statically: no-use-before-define (variables) is enabled in eslint with the existing 57-finding debt triaged (dangerous in-block TDZ fixed, safe module-hoisting annotated or restructured), and the sub-100ms real-timer test census is swept to injectable clocks/schedulers, so runner-only failures cannot hide behind green local runs.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Proven catchable: no-use-before-define ({functions:false, classes:false, variables:true}) flags the exact full-gate failure (query-executor-partition-delivery.js 369:32, run 32623687633) in milliseconds; the rule is absent from eslint.config.js. Repo-wide trial: 57 findings across 26 src files (top: admin-control-snapshot-membership-publication-reconcile 8, diagnostics/budget-timeout-accounting 7) - a mix of safe module-const hoisting and dangerous in-block TDZ; triage before enabling, ratchet if the safe class is kept. Timer census precedents: failure-detector-recovery.property (fixed, injectable clock), migration-recovery-trigger (fixed, injectable scheduler); grep class: real setTimeout/wait windows under 100ms in tests.
